name: blossom
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: native game particle diffuse RGBA texture for a cherry blossom, square UV texture. Edit the supplied original flat native five-petal blossom into a softly realistic, delicate fresh cherry blossom surface. Keep its EXACT overall registration, five-petal count, orientation, and silhouette: one broad rounded petal at 12 o'clock, four at 72 degree intervals, small crimson core centered at image center; no heart notches. Preserve near-full-square coverage and existing transparent empty regions. Make the surface organic, thin, slightly translucent, with pale white-blush pink petals, gentle darker rose coloration close to their bases, subtle fine veins radiating outward, soft shallow folds and restrained curled-edge highlights. Keep redness confined to the tiny center, with a few very fine golden stamens, no large yellow center. Diffuse mostly neutral frontal soft lighting suitable for a game texture; no dramatic directional shadow, no cast shadow. Improve the overly flat paper-cutout look without becoming wrinkled tissue paper, cloth, wax, or thick papier-mache. Front-facing orthographic, one isolated blossom only; no stem/leaves, no scene, no text, no border, no extra objects, no glow. Output square high-quality PNG with a genuinely transparent background and natural soft alpha at delicate petal edges; preserve faint translucent detail, avoid a hard opaque outline.
method: Built-in imagegen editing of a render of the original native geometry.

name: petal
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: native game particle diffuse RGBA texture for one loose cherry blossom petal, square UV texture. Edit the supplied plain native petal silhouette into a softly realistic fresh cherry blossom petal surface. Preserve its registration and shape: a SINGLE broad oval petal standing vertically, smoothly rounded wide top near y=4%, gently tapering attachment end at bottom near y=97%, width about 58% of square centered horizontally; no heart cleft and no pointed sharp tip. Keep the original transparent empty area. Pale white-blush pink, gentle slightly deeper rose only toward attachment end, organic extremely fine longitudinal veins, shallow soft undulations, thin delicate translucent edges, a subtle curled lip suggesting volume. Diffuse neutral soft illumination suitable for a game particle texture, no harsh highlights or deep folds, no cast shadow. It must feel like a fresh thin living petal rather than paper, cardboard, fabric, thick wax, crumpled tissue or papier-mache. Front-facing orthographic view. Exactly one petal, no flower core/stamens, no stem/leaves, no scenery, no text, no border, no glow. Square high-quality PNG, genuinely transparent background with soft natural alpha at the petal edges.
method: Built-in imagegen editing of a render of the original native geometry.
